description: The D-frame k=2 ladder residual computed with the D-frame N=1 factor. The convention-sensitivity probe's D column varies only z and keeps the C-frame cosine cos(a - b*hbar^2/2), so the c_3 ~ -974 recorded in qou-cds1's table is a HYBRID (D-frame z, C-frame N=1). Entry 10 forces the D-frame N=1 to be cos(a_D - h^2/4)*cos(h^2/4), since bar(a_D) + a_D = h^2/2 makes bar a reflection about h^2/4 (QOU.QBeta.N1FactorUniqueness, sorry-free). Measured with the correct N=1, the C-frame rung structure still does not transfer, confirming qou-cds1's 're-derive, do not re-evaluate' from the N=1 side as well as the z side. Scope (a): no c_k proposed, adopted or wired; the convention-D refusal in qbeta_ck_cache is untouched. The entry-9 threshold |c_4| <= target/u^4 is unaffected by the N=1 framing.

checks.name: control_C_phase_is_bar_odd
checks.why: bar(a_C) + a_C = 0 — cos is even, so the bar rule is VACUOUS under C; this is why the C-frame N=1 factor needs no centring

checks.name: control_D_defect_is_h_sq_over_2
checks.why: bar(a_D) + a_D = h^2/2 — so bar reflects about h^2/4 and the D-frame N=1 factor must be centred there (QOU.QBeta.N1FactorUniqueness)

checks.name: D_frame_N1_DIFFERS_from_the_hybrid_the_bean_measured
checks.why: HYBRID N1 = 0.9989991365744098 vs D-frame N1 = 0.9986190619723252, rel 0.0003806 — the sensitivity probe's D column varies only z and keeps the C-frame cosine, so it is NOT the D-frame ladder

checks.name: C_frame_rung_HELPS
checks.why: C: N1 -73821.773 ppb -> N2 -1278.5809 ppb, gain 57.7373x — the ladder is C-built

checks.name: D_frame_rung_gain_MEASURED
checks.why: D-frame (entry-10 centred): N1 -294226.61 ppb -> N2 -221699.41 ppb, gain 1.32714x   [HYBRID for comparison: 1.12042x]

checks.name: centring_does_NOT_rescue_C_like_convergence
checks.why: D-frame gain 1.32714x vs C-frame 57.7373x — the entry-10 centring is the RIGHT N=1 factor and still does not make the C-frame rung structure work under D. The ladder needs re-derivation, which is what qou-cds1 says; this measures it with the correct N=1 for the first time

checks.name: c3_under_D_is_NOT_order_unity
checks.why: an extractor fed the D-frame N=1 would return c_3 = -358.8134454 (HYBRID gives -974.4318877). NOT a proposed value and NOT wired — both are far outside the order-unity range the C-frame c_3 = -2.069 sits in, so 'one derived rung closes the gap' is a C-frame statement, as entry 9 scoped it

checks.name: the_two_D_numbers_are_NOT_the_same_measurement
checks.why: the bean's recorded D column is the HYBRID -974.4318877; with the entry-10 N=1 factor it is -358.8134454, differing by 63.1772 %. Do not quote one for the other

checks.name: entry9_threshold_is_unchanged_by_the_N1_framing
checks.why: |c_4| <= target/u^4 = 1.4816073 regardless of which N=1 factor is used — u = b*hbar^2 carries no Markov parameter and no phase. Only the 'can one rung close it' reading is frame-dependent

data.scope: Scope (a). No c_k proposed, adopted, extracted into a cache or wired; both c_3 figures are what an extractor WOULD return and are labelled as such. qbeta_ck_cache's convention-D refusal is untouched and is not called. c_2 = -1 is used as the structural rung it is.
